title: Urgent priority shift: enterprise on-prem pilot announcement (draft)
content:
Purpose:
- Quick writable draft for an internal announcement + Q&A prep explaining a temporary roadmap priority shift.
- Audience: All engineers + product + sales + security; primary senders: Product leadership (me), Eng leads (Priya/Omar).

Context (short):
- Major enterprise pilot (Arbor Health) committing to a large private deployment if we can meet an air-gapped on-prem packaging and SOC-like audit checklist within ~8 weeks.
- This is an opportunity for a multi-hundred-thousand ARR deal and to accelerate our Private product maturity (packaging, install docs, KMS, audit logs, HSM integration).
- To hit customer commitments we need to temporarily shift some cross-functional capacity from lower-priority roadmap items into the "Enterprise On-Prem Pilot" vertical.

High-level message (what we want everyone to hear):
- We have a time-limited, high-impact customer opportunity. Over the next 6–8 weeks we need coordinated focus to deliver a hardened on-prem pilot for Redwood Private.
- This is a temporary reprioritization — we are not canceling things; we are buffering some items and deferring smaller scope features.
- We’ll share concrete owner-level asks and weekly progress updates.

Draft subject lines (pick one):
- "Temporary roadmap shift: Enterprise on-prem pilot (Arbor Health) — 6–8 week focus"
- "Short-term company priority: Delivering a secure on-prem pilot"

Draft short Slack/Email announcement (for #all or #company):
Hi folks — quick heads up: we’re temporarily prioritizing an enterprise on-prem pilot with Arbor Health that requires an air-gapped, audit-ready packaging. Over the next 6–8 weeks a set of cross-functional teams will shift focus so we can deliver a production-grade pilot.

Details: we’ll publish a short RACI + weekly updates — please read the thread and reach out to your lead if this impacts current sprint commitments.

Why this matters: potential enterprise contract, accelerates Private product maturity, improves packaging and compliance for future customers.

All-hands 2–3 minute talking points (if asked on Monday):
- Quick headline: we have a time-sensitive enterprise pilot; we’re aligning resources to meet the customer timeline.
- Impact: short-term shifts for some teams; disciplined scope trimming so we don’t lose velocity on critical work.
- Upside: large revenue, product-hardening, and faster Private maturity.
- Commitment to transparency: weekly status updates and an open channel for blockers.

What to call this internally (helps consistency):
- "Enterprise On-Prem Pilot (Arbor)" or shorthand "Arbor Pilot". Use the internal tag and Jira prefix ENG-2148 when you reference related work.

Anticipated Q&A (prep answers):
Q1: Is this a permanent roadmap change?
A1: No — temporary, scoped to the pilot. We’ll re-evaluate after the pilot and share timeline for deferred items.

Q2: What gets deferred?
A2: Smaller UX polish items, low-usage experimental features, and a backlog of non-critical infra cleanup. We will publish a precise list by end of week.

Q3: How will this affect release schedules?
A3: Customer-facing releases tied to the pilot will take precedence. Other releases may slip by 1–2 sprints; product and eng leads are finalizing the schedule.

Q4: How will success be measured?
A4: Three checkpoints: 1) reproducible air-gapped package + install docs, 2) automated install test in staging, 3) audit checklist completion (key controls verified) and first pilot install with Arbor.

Q5: Who is the single thread/owner?
A5: Product (Diego) will be the program lead; Priya will be Eng lead for packaging and Omar will be SRE/infra lead. Legal and Security (Lena) will drive audit checklist items.

Q6: Will this pull people from Dedicated/Hosted work?
A6: We will avoid long-term resourcing hits to Hosted SLAs; where necessary we’ll use short-term rotational support and extra on-call coverage.

Q7: What about customer data and security controls?
A7: We are treating this as high priority. KMS/HSM, encryption-at-rest, audit logging, and strict network controls are included. Lena will publish the minimum security controls this week.

Q8: What if teams are blocked?
A8: Use the dedicated Slack channel (#enterprise-pilot) and tag leads; escalate to Diego/Priya/Omar if stuck >48 hours.

Q9: Will we get additional headcount or contractors?
A9: We are evaluating short-term contractor help for packaging automation; hiring is being fast-tracked for one role.

Q10: How do I opt out / how to raise concerns?
A10: Talk to your manager first; if unresolved escalate to Diego/Priya. We want to hear concerns early so we can adjust scope.

Key asks by team (short):
- Eng (Packaging): Build reproducible air-gap bundle, build automated install test, document manual install steps. (Owner: Priya)
- Infra/SRE: Ensure staging runbook, create isolated test environment, support install test infra. (Owner: Omar)
- Security/Compliance: Produce minimum audit controls checklist, run threat model for packaging/air-gap, KMS/HSM integration plan. (Owner: Lena)
- Docs/Developer-Experience: Create ops playbook + install runbook + quickstart. (Owner: TBD - assign this sprint)
- Sales/CS: Coordinate pilot expectations and success metrics with Arbor; keep legal looped on terms. (Owner: Sales lead)

Deliverables and timing (high level):
- Week 1: Finalize scope + publish RACI, freeze list of deferred items.
- Week 2–3: Packaging MVP, staging install automation, security checklist draft.
- Week 4–6: Hardened package, pilot install with Arbor test cluster, fix issues.
- Week 7–8: Pilot review, contract decision point / next steps.

Risks & mitigations (notes to share):
- Risk: Breaks momentum on other teams; Mitigation: time-boxed scope, weekly progress, avoid shifting critical SLA work.
- Risk: Underestimate packaging complexity; Mitigation: quick spike in week 1, bring in contractor if needed.
- Risk: Legal/reg compliance delay; Mitigation: involve Legal immediately and run parallel checklist.

Open questions (needs resolving this sprint):
- Who is assigned Doc owner for the install runbook? (ACTION: Product to assign by EOW)
- Are there procurement/licensing blockers that Arbor has (HSM vendor compatibility)? (ACTION: Sales to confirm)
- Budget for contractor help? (ACTION: Finance review)

Communications plan (who says what):
- Day 0 (announcement): Short company message + link to RACI.
- Weekly: Short status update in #enterprise-pilot and optional sync for folks directly involved.
- All-hands: 2–3 minute update and call for volunteers/rotations if needed.

Internal channels and artifacts:
- Slack: #enterprise-pilot (primary), #engineering (announce summary), #all (company announcement).
- Jira epic: ENG-2148 (track all tasks), label with "arbor-pilot".
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/ENG-PRIORITY-2026 (program page + RACI + meeting notes).

Draft email body (longer form for leads to copy):
Hi team,

We have an important, time-limited opportunity to run an on-prem, air-gapped pilot with Arbor Health. If we deliver a secure, audited packaging and install process within ~6–8 weeks, this could convert into a strategic enterprise contract and meaningfully accelerate our Private product roadmap.

To hit this timeline we’re temporarily prioritizing the Arbor Pilot. Product and Eng leadership have aligned on a short list of deferred items; we’ll publish that list and a RACI by the end of this week.

Please review the program page (link above). If your team will be impacted, talk to your manager — product and eng leads will work with managers to rebalance sprint commitments.

Thanks — Diego (Program lead), Priya (Engineering), Omar (SRE), Lena (Security)

Notes-to-self / quick reminders for send: 
- Add copy for international teams (timezone-friendly meeting cadence).
- Confirm doc owners before sending to #all.
- Run the announcement past Legal for wording about customer name/publicity.

Unresolved policy / legal phrasing to confirm with Legal (Lena):
- Are we allowed to name Arbor Health publicly in a company announcement?
- Standard pilot terms we should not promise (e.g., SLAs until contract signed).

Follow-ups (short action list):
- Publish RACI + deferred list (Owner: Diego) — due Fri EOD.
- Schedule weekly 30m sync starting next Mon (Owner: Priya).
- Create ENG-2148 epic and link initial tasks (Owner: Omar).
- Legal to produce minimum public wording for announcement (Owner: Lena).

End of draft.

— Diego
(Internal draft; please leave comments inline or ping me in #enterprise-pilot)
